profile: Anteris Technologies Global develops structural heart products, including the DurAVR transcatheter heart valve system for aortic stenosis. The system combines a single-piece valve made with ADAPT tissue technology and a balloon-expandable delivery system. The company is conducting clinical studies of DurAVR and developing it for transcatheter aortic valve replacement procedures. ADAPT tissue technology is also used in other cardiac and congenital heart applications.
